metadata.name: CUTandRUN (release v0.12)
annotations: This workflow take as input a collection of paired fastq. Remove adapters with cutadapt, map pairs with bowtie2 allowing dovetail. Keep MAPQ30 and concordant pairs. BAM to BED. MACS2 with "ATAC" parameters.
